I have grown rice on this small plot by the mountain streams for many years, and the water runs close by so my crop does not go thirsty. I will spread cow manure on the soil as I have always done, and I will buy a small amount of urea fertilizer to help the rice grow strong because the agricultural officer advised it. My children and grandchildren will help me with weeding and harvesting, but I will hire young men for five days to assist with the hard work of preparing the paddies.
